name: Cocoa Crawl
paras: Downtown Waco invites families to walk from shop to shop and sip a different hot chocolate at each stop. Participating businesses pour their own festive take, and the host lists stops such as Around the World Bakery, Cottontail Jones, Fabled Bookshop and Cafe and the Performing Arts Community Center.
The $10 mug is the ticket and earns a cup of cocoa at every participating business. After the crawl, guests get a voting link to help crown the year's best cocoa.
tip: Pick up your mug early, since the host lists pickups on Nov 21, Dec 1 and the morning of Dec 5.

name: A Merry Magnolia Christmas Celebration
cost: Adults $50, kids 12 and under $30, ages 2 and under free
paras: Magnolia hosts a one night Christmas evening at the Silos built around a holiday concert by JOHNNYSWIM. The listing also promises Santa visits, complimentary Longhorn photos, Christmas train rides and a fireside s'mores lounge.
Gates open at 5 PM for ticket holders only, and the concert begins at about 7:15 PM. Concert viewing is standing room only and first come, first served.
tip: Arrive when gates open at 5 PM, since a ticket is required for evening entry.

name: A Christmas Carol The Musical
venue: The Performing Arts Community Center (The PACC)
paras: PACC Productions stages Charles Dickens' holiday classic as a musical, with Ebenezer Scrooge visited by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future. The host calls it a story of kindness, community and second chances.
Tickets bought online are $15 for youth and $20 for adults, and door prices run $5 higher. The run goes from December 4 to 13 at the PACC in downtown Waco.
tip: Buy online ahead, since the host lists door prices $5 higher.
